faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask before getting started.
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a1: Not at all. Everything is configured with clicks. If you can use WhatsApp, you can use Parallly. Onboarding walks you through in under 10 minutes.
faq.a2: You upload your information (catalog, FAQs, rules) and pick your industry. The AI learns and replies in your tone. We use advanced models (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini) trained on your business info.
faq.q3: Is it secure? What about my data?
faq.a3: 100% secure. Military-grade encryption (AES-256-GCM), data isolated per company (each tenant has its own database schema), daily backups. Payments processed by MercadoPago — we never touch your CVV. GDPR-compliant.
faq.q4: What if the AI messes up?
faq.a4: No worries. If the AI doesn't know what to say or detects a phrase like 'I want to talk to a human', it hands off to your team instantly with full context. Your team doesn't start from scratch.
faq.a5: 10 minutes to have your AI agent answering with real info. Seriously: connect WhatsApp via official Meta OAuth, pick your industry, upload basic info and you're done.
faq.q6: Does it work in my country?
faq.a6: Yes. Full LatAm phone number support (CO, AR, MX, BR, CL, PE, EC, UY) plus US/Canada. Local currency pricing where applicable (COP, ARS, MXN, CLP, PEN, UYU, BRL, USD).
faq.q7: Can I change plans, pause or cancel?
faq.a7: Anytime. Pause when you go on vacation, cancel at the end of the period (you keep access until then), or cancel immediately. All from a panel — no support calls.
faq.q8: Does it integrate with my current system?
faq.a8: Yes. Open API + webhooks to integrate with your existing ERP/CRM. Parallly brings its own complete CRM, but you can also connect to HubSpot, Salesforce or others.

product.bookingUseCase2Desc: Coach manages 3 calendars for yoga, CrossFit and functional training. Spots update in real time.
product.bookingUseCase3Desc: Table for 4 on Saturday at 8pm. Luca checks availability and sends confirmation with the address.
product.crmDesc: Visual pipeline, automatic scoring, automation and broadcast campaigns.
product.crmSubtitle: A CRM that fills itself: every conversation creates a lead, the pipeline advances automatically and your metrics update in real time.
product.crmFeaturesSubtitle: Everything you need to convert leads into customers, without losing a single one.
product.crmDemoSubtitle: Leads advance automatically through the kanban based on their behavior.
product.crmFeature1Desc: Drag & drop kanban with customizable stages by industry. Leads advance automatically based on behavior.
product.crmFeature2Desc: Automatic scoring based on interactions, purchase intent and engagement. Prioritize the leads that matter most.
product.crmFeature3Desc: One profile per customer with full cross-channel history. Tags, notes, custom fields and timeline.
product.crmFeature4Desc: Trigger → condition → action rules: move to stage, assign tag, send email, notify the team. No code.
product.crmFeature5Desc: Send segmented mass messages by tag, stage or custom field. WhatsApp pre-approved templates.
product.crmUseCase1Desc: Pipeline: Inquiry → Visit → Offer → Close. Carlos qualifies by budget and area, the team closes.
product.crmUseCase2Desc: Roberto logs every quote, schedules automatic follow-ups and alerts the advisor when a lead is hot.
product.crmUseCase3Desc: Segment customers by purchase history, send WhatsApp promos and measure conversion per campaign.
